## Current limitation

Explain the engineering problem and its impact.

## Proposed improvement

Describe the intended technical change and its boundaries.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The change is reproducible from a clean checkout.
- [ ] Quality or security checks cover the change.
- [ ] Operational documentation is updated.
- [ ] No secret or environment-specific configuration is committed.

## Risks and rollback

Describe expected risks and how the team can revert or disable the change.
